subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: Should OpenClaw standardize persistent question summaries plus the web panel-as-composer interaction as the supported cross-platform question model, including the shared transport recovery methods?
rationale: This is a user-facing multi-surface feature and a shared transport contract expansion; correctness evidence cannot determine whether this is the preferred permanent product and API direction.

options.title: Sponsor the unified question model
options.body: Accept persistent summaries, Skip, reconnect recovery, and the web composer takeover as the supported direction after native proof and current-base refresh.

options.title: Narrow the web interaction
options.body: Keep cross-platform recovery improvements but retain the normal composer below the expanded web question panel if concurrent composing remains the desired workflow.

options.title: Split the transport/API decision
options.body: Land only the surface-local behavior after defining a narrower owner-approved recovery seam for shared chat transports.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the unified question model
recommendation.body: Accept persistent summaries, Skip, reconnect recovery, and the web composer takeover as the supported direction after native proof and current-base refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies steipete as the active contributor across the affected native and web question surfaces; an independently verified current-main feature owner was unavailable.
